name: Yinson Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司公告以与 Sumitomo Corporation 的 FPSO/FSO 合作备忘录状态更新为主，三次更新均表示没有重大进展；同时有多份 Take-Overs & Mergers 公告，但未提供内文。最新一季营收同比下降 16.7%，净利润同比上升 26.7%。
overview_en: This year's announcements were mainly status updates on the MOU with Sumitomo Corporation for FPSO/FSO collaboration, with all three updates stating no material development; there were also multiple Take-Overs & Mergers announcements without accompanying text. Latest quarterly revenue fell 16.7% year-on-year while net profit rose 26.7% year-on-year.
